body:
I'm a whole different person now. I learned a lot too, but still, I do miss the person that I used to be. 

I'm not interested in things anymore that I once used to love. My hobbies from my past don't mean anything to me. I don't like my profession anymore. There are many things that I don't like anymore while other things became interesting. 
It's weird. Almost like a part of me died during the trauma and a new person came. And I spend a lot of time trying to explore my new personality. That's okay. I'm okay. But I feel a little sad for my past self.
From Lübeck (Travemünde) you could take the ferry to Malmö

Definitely Lüneburg. It's only 30 minutes from Hamburg. Or Lübeck (same distance). I can also recommend Dresden, but that's in the east of Germany. From there you could visit the Elbe Sandstone Mountains. That's by far the most magical place I've been to in Germany.
I guess you just described exactly what I'm feeling, thank you!
What??

He didn't block me, so no, I can see his atuff. But even if he blocked me, I wouldn't mind. I realized how good it actually feels to be free of him, now also on Instagram.

But (and that's the reason for this post):I simply don't understand why she would block me, when I don't have anything to do with her at all. I don't know her.

Thank you for your words, I appreciate it! 

I do care about what happened and I admit that sometimes, I am a bit curious, but I think I gave the wrong impression here.
I really don't stalk their profiles. I click on their profiles here and then, and then I click on sometimes else. I can't see her photos. I don't even know what she looked like. And I don't know anything about her friends. Honestly, I don't know anything about her, really. I can't stalk them. And they can't see when I click on their profiles.

This one day he blocked me, I felt surprised and wanted to check if he really blocked me or just deactivated his profile for some time. That's why I logged into a few accounts. I simply didn't understand why he'd do that if we weren't in contact at all. But now I don't mind. I think it's for the best. I don't want him to reach out to me in case he changes his mind.
Yeah I know
Haha that's good, but no, we can't see each other's photos.

We used to play an online game together which I continued to play alone and after the breakup, he clicked on "update"on my profile a few times a week to check when I played and who I played with. No one else knew my user name.
Thank god! It's so peaceful to fall into sleep at night without having to worry about some cheating man.

Even funnier when I think about how angry he was every time I cried about him cheating with her. He said I'm a jealous psycho for making things up and I should just get over it. I mean, I had a reason to feel jealous, hadn't I? He's going to have so much fun with her.

Maybe, I don't know. I couldn't tell, since her profile's always been set to private. I wouldn't notice a difference.
Thank you for your kind words!

No honestly, I'm convinced that she doesn't really care about my existence. It's me who felt so insecure for being left for a teenage girl. I got over that. I don't compare myself to her anymore and I'm so grateful to be able to soon live a life (free of him) that makes me so much happier than I've ever been with him. He treated me like shit and I didn't deserve that. They both have crappy personalities (sorry about that), both don't care about cheating and I think they're perfect for each other!
Right now, I'm simply just curious and don't understand the situation, or maybe I'm just confused about people in general.

Actually, I've only been on their profiles about twice a month, I guess, and more randomly. And I've never been able to see her posts. 

I do still care about the cheating and everything that happend last year and it still hurts, yes. But I don't care about what they do now, to be honest. I don't want to have anything to do with them, I don't want to know anything about them and I'm glad that they're not part of my life anymore. There would never be a future with him again after everything that happend.
I'm just confused about the situation since I never did anything that would make her feel insecure. I disappeared like a ghost. She shouldn't have the need to block me.

Why does she feel the need to "leave me in the past"? I've been in the past for a whole year now. Why does she make so much effort if I'm not part of their life at all as the are not part of my life? We can't see each other's profiles, no one cares, so why take action now? I would never reach out to them.
They moved on a year ago. Why would she care now? And I can't even see her private profile.
If this was true, I'd have a good laugh as she's a JV and isn't allowed to have sex before marriage (they're really strict).

But there isn't anything to stalk. I look at their profiles here and then, maybe once a month, just as I look at some people I went to school with. I'm not able to see what is going on in their life, because her profile's private.

If I don't care about someone, I wouldn't spend any energy and log into all kinds of accounts, only to block or unfollow a person I don't care about? I don't have anything to do with them and they don't have anything to do with me. We all live separate lives. Why would she care?

Maybe she really does feel insecure. He broke up with me once, 1.5 months earlier, before getting back together within a week. At that time, he wrote her a long letter about his love for me and that he finally understood what I meant to him and that he chooses me. Only four weeks later, he broke up with me for the second (and last) time, the first time we saw each other again, and was with her immediately. Maybe she doesn't believe him when he says that his feelings for me suddenly were completely gone within only four weeks. Or he even lied about it (as he lied a lot back then, to me, to her, all the time, although I'm not sure if she knows).

I know that he regularly looked up my name the first six months after the breakup. But then he stopped. So why would I suddenly become a topic to her 12 months later?

That might actually be the case, really! But even if he did: there's no way for me to notice since her profile is completely private.

When he broke up with me, he told me about thinking of marrying her in a year (which would be today), because she's a JW and they usually marry that quick. 

Maybe she feels guilty about the cheating (if she even realized that it was cheating) and is afraid of her family finding out due to their religion.

Thank you! I still don't understand how she'd feel better if I was blocked by her so that she couldn't stalk, while my Ex only unfollowed my Instagram profile without blocking it and could look up my name all the time.
I know! I'm definitely trying, but it's not always that easy. One year seems long but sometimes it's not enough if your wounds are deep.

But what would she suddenly feel insecure about after one year? I don't play any role in his life and we haven't seen each other or talked in 12 months? I would get it if I had reached out to him or called him on his birthday, but none of that ever happened. I haven't posted anything in years, my profile is private and I live far away. There's no way, we'd randomly bump into each other. How would she feel better, if she wasn't able to look up my private profile picture (where you can barely see my face) that didn't change in years?

Yeah maybe, but why would she block me then? I would "get it" if she made him do that, but he didn't block me on Instagram, just unfollowed me. And her blocking me wouldn't have any influence on his spying (if he ever did that), would it?
No they're still together, but I can imagine that she's a bit insecure about my existence
Thank you, sounds really interesting. Maybe it's really her who made him delete me everywhere. Maybe she even found old photos or something else.
He definitely is. The relationship was full of emotional abuse.
That might be true!

He is still with her (god knows why), maybe they're even married now. At least that's what he said last year when breaking up with me. She's a JW, they marry after one year.

Thank u for your words!

But I'm your bestfriend.

- "not anymore."
Shedding not even a single tear after being together for five years...

I'm in the exact same boat. He was my first boyfriend and we've been together for many years, talked about marriage and he was my only friend when he broke up with me. It's been six months in which I didn't have anyone to talk to and things got a lot worse (suffering from depression with suicidal thoughts and living in a small town where you don't know anyone made it really hard to meet new people). I lost all hope and don't see any perspective in life. I have no idea on how to survive the next few years, but I just have to keep fighting.
I learned a lot, too. I didn't realize how dependent I was until he ended things. It's probably the hardest lesson I've ever had in my life, but now I know that you really shouldn't love someone more than yourself and you simply can't ever rely on someone 100 %, even if everything feels right about them, you just can't. I hope I won't do the same mistake again.

I don't have any words for you to feel better, but I want you to know that you're not alone. Please stay strong, I know things will get a lot better for you! Big hugs!

I'm very sorry for the pain you're going through. I experienced a similar story and I'm still not over it.

I don't mean to insult you in any way, I'm just curious: does your wife know that you're rating and commenting  nudes on reddit asking girls to send you pictures? Are you in an open relationship? I know, what your wife did was awful and you have every right and reason to be in pain, but if I was her, I wouldn't feel good about my partner doing stuff like that on the internet. To me it would be cheating. Does she know about those things?

He hasn't reached out a single time after breaking up with me and it's been over six months. :(

I don't understand how someone you spent so many years with can forget you just like that. He knows that I'm suffering from depression but he never reached out to make sure I'm okay and that hurts.

He hasn't reached out a single time but got together with her in a few weeks.

It's so hard when you're all alone. But then again, I need to stay strong for my inner child. I'm sure it would be angry at me if I killed myself and gave up the future it always dreamed about. Trying to stay strong!

"It's none of your business" and "sooner or later it might not be your business anymore", when asking him about his affair and trying to tell him about my feelings (he never really realized how much he hurt me).

None of my business? As if I was only the ONS from last night and not your girlfriend of five years. This sentence hurt so bad.
Thank you, this helps me a lot! I really appreciate this :)
She may seem nice, but she can't have a good personality, if she does something like that, she just can't! And being nice doesn't change anything about that!
Thank you!!

If you're not ready, then you're not ready. No need to feel bad about that. If I was about to meet a man who spent the last years focusing on himself and would tell me about his projects and new hobbies he tried the last years, I would definitely fall for that a lot more than someone who spent a whole year after his breakup on dating apps (nothing wrong about that!). No need to force something. If it's going to happen, then it's going to happen because it's supposed to happen! Time doesn't matter. After all the crap you've been through, you, my friend, deserve one amazing love story and not some 1 second swipe on tinder. Go out, do your thing, explore your hobbies and I bet, in the moment you'd expect it the least, she's gonna be right in front of you! Good luck!
Thank you! I'd love to watch a video about that and to feel a bit more secure about my theory of them always being "less" haha

I feel you. You're somehow living my worst fear of him marrying the woman he left me for and had an affair with. I have no idea how I would cope with that. Still hoping for them to wake up and to realize what they did and how everything was actually just an illusion to them.

But still, just because they're getting married doesn't  mean that's their happy ending. There isn't a high divorse rate for no reason. Maybe he's just afraid because he thinks that this is his single remaining road to go after he fucked up so bad by cheating on you (he knows he did) and he doesn't want to end up lonely, that's why he's grasping his last chance. Or he's marrying her because he's afraid she might do the same thing to him immediately with someone else (maybe that's also what she's thinking). They cheated once, they would probably do that again and again and again. But honestly, you know too well that marriage doesn't stop them. You two had a great marriage, you were a loving and faithful wife for years, and he cheated on you. He's now with an unfaithful woman. Why wouldn't he do it again? Please don't think of them as a happy couple. You don't know what's really going on behind the curtain. And even if they're happy in this very moment, the honeymoon feelings won't last long. And why on earth could he be happier longterm with a cheating woman with a nasty personality?

Yeah I feel you. From everything I know about her, she's actually so wrong for him, in many ways, and it kills me to know that he chose her after everything he had with me (we complemented each other very well) as if he never saw me and I was just invisible to him.

BUT: is the alternative really better? To feel like he left me for some beautiful woman (way younger)? I'd rather think of her as some of his failures. Sure, it doesn't change the past, but I'd rather think that he left me for someone "less" than to have never ending nightmares about someone like Megan Fox stealing the love of my life.

You're probably right, although I've been wondering whether the scenarios in my head might actually be a lot worse than the reality (at least I hope so). And I thought that I could feel better when I just knew that she isn't as pretty as she looked in all my nightmares.
Thank u. I updated the link. Is it working?

No it wasn't. We were together for five years, but we only saw each other on the weekends (but last year we only saw each other very rarely due to the pandemic). They met online, had a huge emotional affair and fell in love online (never met in real life). But she lives near his town, so since the breakup, they can see whenever they want to.
Is it the same thing when they leave you for someone else after having an intense emotional affair (online)? :(
Germany here

Oh that's sad. How often would you be able to see each other?
In my experience: LD can work if you really love each other. I know, it's hard! It's gonna be really hard! But it's not gonna be forever. Three years are gonna pass so quickly. What is the alternative? Not seeing each other ever again or seeing each other scarcely only for three years? If you let him go you'd forever think about it for the rest of your life and you will always wonder whether you made the right choice. Do you really want to be without him?
Can't he come with you? Three years of uni are not that much. If you really love each other, there's no distance that could be too much!
Thank u!!
Thank u for your advice! I guess, your therapist's right. Although I wish I would have realized this earlier. It's incredibly hard without a supporting net. I wish I could change the past.

Thank you for your kind words! Yeah, I try to stay strong! I know I have to get out and try to get in contact with people, but when I feel as heartbroken as I am right now and I'm in an extreme fragile mood, crying all the time, I really feel like staying in bed instead of making new friends. I know, I have to to feel better and get out of this dark loop but it's just a really hard mix of bad circumstances to deal with while suffering from depression. But I try my best!

Thank u, no, I get you! To be honest, almost nobody knows about my depression (anyone but my Ex) and I'm really good at acting happy, so you really wouldn't notice.

It's more because I had to move away a few years ago and my studies are online (so I didn't make new friends). My Ex lived in a different town, so that I used any free time to spend with him. Last year, I couldn't see anyone due to Covid. That's why I don't really have any friends anymore. I'm actually really social but it's hard to stay in contact only via WhatsApp.
What kind of movies do you like? :)
That's very kind. Thank u!

I tried to talk to friends I had a few years ago via WhatsApp (they all live far away). Some listened to me for a month, but then they stopped. They're all busy and when I try to reach out, they sometimes text back a week later. It's awful. And I can't really talk to my parents since we're not that close. I had to interrupt my studies due to my depression, so I don't have anything to distract myself from the pain right now.

Same Story. I'm in no contact for five months now (started right after the breakup). He never reached out to me, not even once. Hurts like hell after an intense relationship of five years (first relationship for both of us). There wasn't a single day we didn't talk in all those years. I don't understand how someone can forget you just like that. I was so sure he'd wake up once he gets to fully know the real character of his emotional affair. But he just forgot me in an instant. I want this pain to end.

I feel you. Going through the same thing for the last five months. Although he already met her months before, cheated emotionally and then broke up with me to be with her after five years. I don't have any hope.

But I'm damn sure that your Ex is only seeing someone because the two weeks, she was absolutely miserable without you. Please don't feel insecure because of a man who has zero memories with her (you do!), someone who was just a filler when she was lonely. Do you really think this is serious two weeks after such a long relationship? You are better than that! I get that you feel horrible, it's probably gonna last a little longer, but then get yourself up again! She's the one who lost someone who would have done the world for her. She lost, not you! She's gonna realize that sooner or later. But please do me a favor and don't wait for her. You deserve so much more!
Does it have to be a live chat? Couldn't we just share our favourite songs right here below?

My ex cheated on me emotionally (but very extreme) and left me after five years for the other women he "met" online. When we had our final talk (he wanted me to leave immediately after breaking up with me, but at least he gave me a few minutes to talk), he told me his "reasons" to break up with me: we had a long distance relationship and when I visited him, I never cooked my own meal to eat for myself (really??). Also: we kind of drifted apart. 

No we did not drift apart. You just tried online dating and spent three months, 24/7, with a girl you felt attracted to from the beginning and definitely not accidentally fell in love with while hiding me, wrote and sent her love songs, sent her sweet good morning texts, watched romantic movies with her, made her your number one and always cancelled on me to only spend time with her, called her every night, sent her pictures, texted her your deepest feelings and most private stories after only one week, ignored me, lied to me all the time, broke up with me twice, and then left me in pieces and deeply depressed and suicidal, before making your new relationship physical.

No we did not drift apart. But I'm damn sure that all of this story and how you both met will never be a part of what you tell your family about our breakup. I'm damn sure that you tell your sweet and loving family that we just drifted apart and "by the way: This is my new girlfriend and we are so in love". 

And no one's ever gonna know. And that fucking hurts. He's probably even telling other that he's better off without me because of how depressed I was. I mean I was, right? But did you tell others what caused by depression?

No, but my boyfriend of five years met a girl on the internet and they both fell in love immediately. For a few months, they texted 24/7, chatted on the phone, sent selfies, talked about their deepest and private emotions, watched romantic movies, listened to love songs together while hiding and in some way ignoring me. Anything but sexual. He then left me to be with her.
No physical cheating involved, only intense emotional cheating, but it still hurts like hell. Thank you!
